confidence.rationale: Current U.S. Auntie Anne's nutrition/allergen guide is restaurant-issued and identifies U.S. menu items and an allergen matrix. The frozen baseline instead derives from a Mexico-domain chart marked confidential and revised 05.13.16; its location and vintage do not support the U.S. national restaurant scope. Every baseline key is therefore reconciled as a location mismatch, with the frozen allergen attribution mismatched for this scope.

sources.title: Auntie Anne's Nutritional Guide
sources.excerpt: The guide identifies auntieannes.com and ©2025 Auntie Anne's Franchisor SPV LLC. Its allergen statement says all food and beverage items may contain or come into contact with allergens; its matrix lists current U.S. pretzels, dogs, breakfast sandwiches, dips, lemonade products, smoothies, spritzes, and coffee.

sources.title: Food Allergens and Sensitivities for Auntie Anne's Pretzels & Products
sources.excerpt: The one-page chart is hosted on auntieannes.com.mx, says “Confidential Revised 05.13.16,” and lists the 37 frozen baseline product labels. It warns that products may share equipment and that the chart does not guarantee products are allergen-free.

findings.summary: All 37 frozen baseline items and their allergen fields trace to a Mexico-domain matrix marked confidential and revised 05.13.16, while this job identifies the U.S. national Auntie Anne's scope. The current U.S. official guide has a different current product structure and allergen matrix. The frozen source cannot verify U.S.-scope allergen claims.
